lede: The headline this week is Tuesday's Town Council meeting, where the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code goes to its third and final reading — a vote that would rewrite the Land Use Code's rules on historic review, landscaping, and tree maintenance for every property owner in town. Alongside that, the county Planning Commission takes up subdivision mechanics and a building energy code update on Thursday, both of which shape how land gets divided and built on across San Miguel County. In between, the valley is humming with Jazz Fest spillover, the KOTO Duck Race, and Ridgway Rendezvous wrapping up the weekend.

notable.stake: Final vote on wildfire code that rewrites historic review and landscaping rules.
County weighs subdivision rules and a new energy code for all new construction.
